significance: A Hanuman temple in Khar West, Mumbai, founded in 1960 by a local man, Sakharam Rahate, and busiest on Tuesdays and Saturdays and at Hanuman Jayanti. Its name comes from the great number of bells hung about it.
story: Devotees hold that a wish granted here must be repaid with a bell, which is why the temple has accumulated so many.
